svg.title: Known-best packing of 68 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=68 construction, normalized to Witness/v1 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Coordinates were recovered from the public six-decimal SVG rendering, not the unavailable governed interval boxes named by its metadata. This checks the displayed construction only and does not replay the source's interval claim or prove optimality.

svg.text: N n=68 known best: side ~ 8.803383075 (numerically checked)
